translations.web: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.
translations.bsb: Her spirit returned, and at once she got up. And He directed that she be given something to eat.
translations.kjv: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
